title: Light Mustardy Peruvian Shrimp Chupe De Camarones
description: A light and flavorful Peruvian shrimp stew featuring sumac and a hint of mustard, perfect for a sick day pick me up
instructions: Heat the chicken broth and white wine in a large pot over medium heat until simmering.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the diced potatoes to the pot and cook for 10 minutes or until they are slightly tender.
Add the shrimp to the pot and cook until they are pink and fully cooked.
Stir in the sumac, mustard, salt, and black pepper.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew for 5 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional sumac if desired.
To make nigiri-shaped shrimp, shape cooked shrimp into small oval shapes and serve on top of the stew.
